## About
TOS Wheels and Tires LLC is a tire and auto repair shop on Bothell Way NE. We sell car, truck and SUV tires, do Hunter Hawkeye wheel alignments, fix brakes and handle steering and suspension repair. Custom wheels too.
Two reviewers mention Oliver by name. One came in to get tires mounted, forgot lug nuts, and left with the parts sorted and a straight steering wheel after an alignment. Another hit a median while delivering for DoorDash and got back on the road on the spare.
We also have shops in Lynnwood and Marysville. Folks rate us 4.4 from 194 Google reviews.

## Services
- Car, Truck & SUV Tires: Tires for your car, truck or SUV. Shop by vehicle or license plate on our site, or come in and we'll get them mounted.
- Hunter Hawkeye Wheel Alignment: Wheel alignments that get your steering wheel straight again. One reviewer said his car drives great after.
- Brake Repair: Brake work done right here at the shop.
- Steering & Suspension Repair: Steering and suspension repair for when the car pulls, wanders or just doesn't feel right.
- Custom Wheels: New wheels for your ride, mounted and put back together right.
- Electric car repairs, general auto maintenance and diagnostics: Our team works on electric cars as well as everyday maintenance and diagnostics.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Sunday hours are shorter, so give us a call before you head over.

Q: Do you work on electric cars?
A: Yes. Our team works on electric cars, and one reviewer brought his Tesla Model Y in for an alignment.

Q: Can I pay over time?
A: We offer purchase options through SNAP and Synchrony. Ask us about them when you come in.

Q: Does anyone there speak Spanish?
A: One reviewer said the crew is bilingual in Spanish.

Q: Do you have other locations?
A: Yes. Along with Bothell, we have shops in Lynnwood and Marysville.

We discussed a price then and there for the additional work.
